title: Reliability
description: A reliable workload is one that is both resilient and available. Resiliency is the ability of the workload to recover from failures and continue to function. Availability is whether your users can access your workload when they need to.

recommendations.title: Simplify
recommendations.description: Design your workload to be simple. Minimize the components, dependencies, and complexity to reduce the risk of failures.

recommendations.title: Identify critical flows
recommendations.description: Identify and prioritize your workload's critical flows. Use this information to focus reliability efforts where they matter most.

recommendations.title: Failure mode analysis
recommendations.description: Identify potential failure points in your workload so that you can build in resiliency and self-preservation capabilities.

recommendations.title: Define reliability targets
recommendations.description: Define reliability targets (SLOs, SLAs, RPO, RTO) for all flows and components to guide design decisions.

recommendations.title: Use redundancy
recommendations.description: Add redundancy at different layers of the workload to remove single points of failure and achieve higher availability.

recommendations.title: Design for scaling
recommendations.description: Design for scaling to handle expected and unexpected increases in load and ensure elastic capacity.

recommendations.title: Self-preservation
recommendations.description: Strengthen the resiliency of your workload by implementing error handling, transient fault handling, and graceful degradation.

recommendations.title: Testing strategy
recommendations.description: Test for resiliency and availability scenarios by applying the principles of chaos engineering and validating reliability targets.

recommendations.title: Disaster recovery
recommendations.description: Implement structured, tested, and documented disaster recovery plans that align with the negotiated recovery targets.

recommendations.title: Monitoring and alerting
recommendations.description: Measure and publish the solution's health indicators. Continuously capture uptime and other reliability data from across the workload.

title: Security
description: The security pillar focuses on the protection of data, systems, and assets, while providing business value through risk assessments and meeting compliance requirements. A secure workload is resilient to attacks and incorporates the interrelated security principles of confidentiality, integrity, and availability.

recommendations.title: Security baseline
recommendations.description: Establish a security baseline by mapping compliance requirements and understanding the threat landscape of your workload.

recommendations.title: Secure development lifecycle
recommendations.description: Adopt a secure development lifecycle with security practices across the entire software development and operations lifecycle.

recommendations.title: Data classification
recommendations.description: Classify and label data based on its sensitivity and apply appropriate controls to protect it at rest, in transit, and in use.

recommendations.title: Segmentation
recommendations.description: Segment your workload into boundaries and control the flow of network traffic between segments to limit lateral movement.

recommendations.title: Identity and access
recommendations.description: Implement a layered identity and access management strategy by granting only the minimum required permissions to identities.

recommendations.title: Network security
recommendations.description: Align network segmentation strategy with business requirements. Reduce the network footprint by limiting access to resources.

recommendations.title: Encryption
recommendations.description: Protect data confidentiality and integrity by using encryption. Apply encryption at all layers to prevent unauthorized access.

recommendations.title: Harden resources
recommendations.description: Reduce attack surface area by hardening your resources. Apply security baselines to all components and services.

recommendations.title: Application secrets
recommendations.description: Protect sensitive application configurations and secrets. Prevent accidental disclosure and unauthorized access.

recommendations.title: Monitor threats
recommendations.description: Continuously monitor for threats and anomalies. Implement threat intelligence and detection capabilities across the workload.

recommendations.title: Security testing
recommendations.description: Establish a security testing regimen that validates defenses, validates compliance requirements, and tests response procedures.

recommendations.title: Incident response
recommendations.description: Define, test, and execute a security incident response plan that acknowledges, contains, and resolves attack vectors.

title: Cost Optimization
description: Cost optimization is about looking at ways to reduce unnecessary expenses and improve operational efficiencies. A cost-optimized workload is one where the actual spending is appropriate for what the workload delivers in terms of business value.

recommendations.title: Financial responsibility culture
recommendations.description: Foster a culture of financial responsibility by sharing cost visibility and accountability across teams.

recommendations.title: Cost model
recommendations.description: Develop a cost model for the workload and establish spending guardrails to keep costs within budget.

recommendations.title: Collect and review cost data
recommendations.description: Collect and review cost data to understand spending patterns and identify optimization opportunities.

recommendations.title: Spending guardrails
recommendations.description: Set budget alerts and spending guardrails to prevent accidental overspending and enforce cost policies.

recommendations.title: Get best rates
recommendations.description: Use Azure pricing models (reservations, savings plans, spot) to get the best rates for your workload.

recommendations.title: Align usage to billing
recommendations.description: Align resource consumption to billing increments to eliminate waste and avoid paying for unused capacity.

recommendations.title: Optimize component costs
recommendations.description: Optimize individual resource and component costs by right-sizing and selecting the most cost-effective SKUs.

recommendations.title: Optimize environment costs
recommendations.description: Reduce costs in non-production environments through automation, scheduling, and shared resource strategies.

recommendations.title: Optimize flow costs
recommendations.description: Optimize end-to-end workload flows for cost efficiency by eliminating redundancy and reducing unnecessary data transfers.

recommendations.title: Optimize data costs
recommendations.description: Reduce data storage and processing costs through tiering, compression, archival, and lifecycle management.

recommendations.title: Optimize code costs
recommendations.description: Optimize application code to reduce resource utilization and improve efficiency, directly lowering compute costs.

recommendations.title: Optimize scaling costs
recommendations.description: Design scaling policies that efficiently match resource capacity to actual demand to minimize over-provisioning.

recommendations.title: Optimize personnel time
recommendations.description: Automate operational tasks to reduce manual labor and free up team members for higher-value activities.

recommendations.title: Consolidation
recommendations.description: Consolidate resources and workloads to reduce duplication, improve utilization, and lower overall costs.

title: Operational Excellence
description: Operational excellence covers the operations processes that keep a workload running in production. The principles of operational excellence are based on continuous improvement, standardization, and observable systems.

recommendations.title: DevOps culture
recommendations.description: Establish a DevOps culture that promotes collaboration, shared responsibility, and continuous improvement across teams.

recommendations.title: Formalize operations tasks
recommendations.description: Document and standardize routine operational tasks through runbooks, playbooks, and well-defined processes.

recommendations.title: Development practices
recommendations.description: Adopt standardized development practices including coding standards, code reviews, and documentation.

recommendations.title: Tools and processes
recommendations.description: Standardize tools and processes across the workload lifecycle to improve efficiency and reduce operational friction.

recommendations.title: Infrastructure as Code
recommendations.description: Manage infrastructure resources through code to ensure consistency, repeatability, and version control.

recommendations.title: Workload supply chain
recommendations.description: Manage and secure the workload's software supply chain to ensure quality, security, and reliability.

recommendations.title: Observability
recommendations.description: Design and implement monitoring and observability capabilities to gain insight into workload health and behavior.

recommendations.title: Incident response
recommendations.description: Establish and practice incident response procedures to detect, diagnose, and resolve operational issues quickly.

recommendations.title: Automate tasks
recommendations.description: Automate routine operational tasks to improve consistency, reduce errors, and free up team capacity.

recommendations.title: Enable automation
recommendations.description: Build the capabilities and infrastructure needed to support automation at scale across the workload.

recommendations.title: Safe deployments
recommendations.description: Implement safe deployment practices to reduce the risk of production incidents during releases.

title: Performance Efficiency
description: Performance efficiency is the ability of your workload to scale to meet the demands placed on it by users in an efficient manner. Just as a physical infrastructure has limits, cloud architectures also have performance ceilings if you don't design for scalability.

recommendations.title: Performance targets
recommendations.description: Define and validate performance targets that are driven by business requirements and user expectations.

recommendations.title: Capacity planning
recommendations.description: Conduct capacity planning to ensure the workload can handle expected load and unexpected spikes.

recommendations.title: Select services
recommendations.description: Select Azure services that can meet performance requirements and scale appropriately with your workload's needs.

recommendations.title: Collect performance data
recommendations.description: Collect and analyze performance data to understand baseline performance and identify bottlenecks.

recommendations.title: Scale and partition
recommendations.description: Scale resources and partition workloads to distribute load and avoid performance bottlenecks.

recommendations.title: Performance testing
recommendations.description: Test for performance regularly to validate that the workload meets performance targets under expected and peak loads.

recommendations.title: Optimize code and infrastructure
recommendations.description: Optimize application code and infrastructure configuration to improve resource utilization and throughput.

recommendations.title: Optimize data performance
recommendations.description: Optimize data storage and access patterns to improve query performance and reduce latency.

recommendations.title: Prioritize critical flows
recommendations.description: Identify and prioritize performance optimization for the most critical user flows and business scenarios.

recommendations.title: Optimize operational tasks
recommendations.description: Optimize background and operational tasks to avoid impacting user-facing performance and throughput.

recommendations.title: Respond to live issues
recommendations.description: Establish processes to detect and respond to live performance issues quickly to minimize user impact.

recommendations.title: Continuous optimization
recommendations.description: Continuously optimize performance through experimentation, profiling, and incremental improvement over time.
